title: DP branch: ArcFace (insightface buffalo_l), AdaFace IR-101 and SpeechBrain ECAPA 192 / 6144 features of the two English Evaluation files

inputs.note: eval_set.zip, the zip the DP branch read on 16/11; when only the extracted dataset view is available the stage rebuilds the zip; either way its members are checked against stages/10_raw/raw_evalphase/expected/eval_set_members.sha256

verify.rule: information (equal only on the team machine / libraries)

extract_eval.py.old: import io, json, sys, time, zipfile
extract_eval.py.new: import io, json, os, sys, time, zipfile
extract_eval.py.why: os is needed to read the path variables below

extract_eval.py.new: sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("DP_CODE", str(REPO / "kaggle")))   # FF repo: folder holding flag_extract.py / flag_models.py
extract_eval.py.why: the helper modules sit in the stage folder, not in <team repo>/kaggle

extract_eval.py.new: OUT = Path(os.environ.get("DP_EVAL_FEATS", HERE / "feats_evalphase")); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)   # FF repo: output folder
extract_eval.py.why: the stage folder is read-only; output goes to the stage's working folder

extract_eval.py.new: KO = Path(os.environ.get("DP_FEATS", REPO / "kaggle" / "output"))   # FF repo: dp_feats folder of stage dp_feats_layout
extract_eval.py.why: reference train arrays (self-check) come from stage dp_feats_layout

extract_eval.py.new: tz = zipfile.ZipFile(os.environ.get("DP_TRAIN_ZIP", REPO / "Input" / "train_set.zip"))   # FF repo: organisers' train_set.zip
extract_eval.py.why: organisers' train zip from FF_DATA/00_raw/btc_mavceleb_v4 (only the 20 self-check rows are read)

extract_eval.py.new:
ver["adaface_error"] = repr(e)[:300]; X.log("AdaFace skipped:", ver["adaface_error"])
    raise   # FF repo: never skip AdaFace silently (xjf.py needs face_adaface_*; DESIGN WP-I, S7 gap 10)
extract_eval.py.why: the original swallowed any AdaFace error and went on; xjf.py then fails later without the AdaFace arrays
extract_eval.py.effect_on_numbers: none: the 16/11 run took the success path (extract.log 01:31:53 'AdaFace check', 01:38:59 / 01:46:14 'adaface ... done')

extract_eval.py.new: ec = X.Ecapa(Path(os.environ.get("DP_ECAPA_SB", KO / "_ecapa_sb")))   # FF repo: pinned speechbrain savedir (stage cell 2)
extract_eval.py.why: the SpeechBrain savedir (5 files of speechbrain/spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb@0f99f2d0) is prepared by the stage, not kept under kaggle/output

flag_models.py.new: path = snapshot_download(self.ID, revision=os.environ.get("FF_ADAFACE_REVISION", "54f602a0737bd1ee4a4e7e9fd089a485f397fefd"))   # FF repo: pinned (= HF cache snapshot used on 16/11)
flag_models.py.why: the original took the latest revision of minchul/cvlface_adaface_ir101_webface12m; the team machine's cache (refs/main) held only snapshot 54f602a0, so that is what ran
flag_models.py.effect_on_numbers: none if the hub file is unchanged (pretrained_model/model.pt sha256 e312d792... checked by the stage)

env_spec: docker/requirements-dp-local.txt (team CPU machine: Python 3.14.0, torch 2.12.1+cpu, numpy 2.3.5, pandas 3.0.5, insightface 2.0, onnxruntime 1.31.1, speechbrain 1.1.2; S8 E3)

env_overrides.DP_EVAL_ZIP: path of eval_set.zip (else the raw_evalphase output, else rebuilt from the evalphase view; members checked)
env_overrides.DP_TMP: scratch folder (unpacked media, rebuilt zips, model copies); default FF_WORK/tmp, emptied at every run (<base>/ff_dp/<stage>)
env_overrides.DP_HF_CACHE: Hugging Face cache holding the AdaFace snapshot
env_overrides.DP_DEVICE: cpu (default, as the original run) | gpu
env_overrides.DP_LANGS: English (default; the submission uses only the English files)
env_overrides.DP_FEATS_DIR: folder holding feats_v2/, feats_models/, feats_eval/, feats_ext_full/ with the 20 files of dp_feats_layout/dp_features.json (else found by structure in the dp_feats_layout input)
env_overrides.DP_ALLOW_INPUT_MISMATCH: 1 = go on when an input differs from the submission's: lid_strict.json not version 2, a saved dp_feats copy whose files differ from dp_features.json, eval_set.zip members that differ from the submitted zip

reads_undeclared: FF_DATA/<entry>/06_pretrained: optional local copies of the three DP models (found by sha256 / HF cache folder name); without them the pinned versions are downloaded (models.json)
python_packages_checked: cell 1 stops with the list of missing packages (insightface, onnxruntime, speechbrain, omegaconf, huggingface_hub, ...) and points to docker/requirements-dp-local.txt / docker/requirements-kaggle-pinned.txt; pip_policy stays 'skip' (the runner has no per-stage requirement subset)
